audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: riven__sett moved Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Riven and 2+ items to Skill in both its layers. The two directions must match.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side/win[3] and phases[4].side/win[4] to Riven, phases[6].side/win[6] to Skill, as matched pairs; the three 'why' lines that claimed Sett wins those stages rewritten with them. Existing ratings (4/10, 4/10, 5/10) already fit the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike said the trade math swings to Sett, contradicting the mirror's chart, and the level-6 spike undersold why her ult beats your grab.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile (120/90/60s) gives bonus AD and RANGE plus one Wind Slash; The Show Stopper reaches only 400 and Wind Slash is cast at range. Valor (E, 10/9/8/7/6s) is a short dash that BLOCKS damage — cashing Haymaker into it wastes the whole Grit bar.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and spikes[2] rewritten with the ranges, cooldowns and the block interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Slash was called an 'execute' in four places, and Facebreaker's stun condition was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text calls Wind Slash 'a powerful ranged attack' — nothing about a health threshold. Facebreaker stuns only when it catches enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett, so against a lone Riven it just slows unless you line a minion up behind her.
audit.corrected: whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3] and wants.foe[2] drop the execute claim; dosFull[2].d states the both-sides rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommended Executioner's Calling because 'his healing out-paces your grit trades'.
audit.why: Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit — Valor is a damage block, not a heal — and the line also uses the wrong pronoun. Buying Grievous Wounds here is wasted gold.
audit.corrected: First back changed to the standard Phage / Tiamat + boots line.

edits.before: At 6 your durability and grit shields let you weather her burst and answer with R.
edits.after: At 6 Blade of the Exile adds damage and range, and Wind Slash finishes you.

edits.before: First item makes your W true damage and shields strong enough to out-trade her combo.
edits.after: First item keeps her ahead — her combo lands before your Grit bar is worth cashing.

edits.before: Late, a fed Riven's animation-cancel burst and Wind Slash (R) execute can still delete you first.
edits.after: Late it is skill — her animation-cancel burst against your max-grit Haymaker and its shield.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Riven doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile (120s at rank 1) gives her damage and range plus a one-shot Wind Slash. Do not stand in that window low.

edits.before: Riven's level 6 Blade of the Exile plus Wind Slash (R) burst spikes hard; her extra range and execute can blow you up before you land R, so respect the all-in.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile (120s at rank 1) gives extra damage and range plus one Wind Slash, and she casts it from further out than your 400-range grab — respect the all-in.

edits.before: After your first item Sett's grit shields and W true damage let you tank her combo and answer — the trade math swings back to you once you're durable.
edits.after: First item still favours her: Valor (E, 10s at rank 1) is a short dash that blocks damage, so your Haymaker cashes into a block unless you bait it out first.

edits.before: Riven's snowball mechanics keep her a lane threat; if she's fed her animation-cancel burst and R execute can still delete you, so late fights stay dangerous.
edits.after: Riven's snowball mechanics keep her a lane threat; fed, her animation-cancel burst plus a Wind Slash finish can still delete you, so late fights stay dangerous.

edits.before: Stay ahead so her execute can still one-combo you
edits.after: Stay ahead so her full combo still one-shots you

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Riven Ki Burst: Short-range AoE stun — her engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Riven Ki Burst (W, 260 range, 11s at rank 1): her stun and combo starter — bait it out. - Riven Valor (E, 10s at rank 1): a short dash that blocks damage; never cash Haymaker into it.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: An 11s stun at rank 1. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Riven wastes Ki Burst (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Facebreaker only stuns with a body on her far side — line it up.

edits.before: Track Riven's Ki Burst (Stun): Her engage CC. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + W her.
edits.after: Track Riven's Ki Burst: an 11s stun at rank 1. When it is down — E-stun + W her.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — his healing out-paces your grit trades.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Phage / Tiamat + boots (≈1300g) — Riven has no healing to cut.

notes: Sett's R carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support, so nothing here claims The Show Stopper denies Broken Wings or Valor — but tldr and winCon still say 'all-in grounded', which is that same unsupported claim in the two most prominent strings on the page. I left them alone rather than rewrite around an unverified mechanic; they need either a source or a rewrite. Riven's animation-cancel timings are not in Riot's text and no specific cancel is asserted. Packet games (1930) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (2105).
